title: OKX + ICE put 113 stocks onchain 24/7, Strategy adds 457 BTC, Bitmine keeps buying ETH
caption:
deal flow 🏦 okxice, the okx x intercontinental exchange joint venture, launched 113 tokenized stocks and etfs trading 24/7 for eligible us customers, but 67 companies incl. apple, nvidia and tesla objected. strategy bought 457 btc for $29.6m (avg $64,898), now holds 851,305 btc, and bought back $211.8m of strc preferred. bitmine added 7,819 eth. would you trade stocks onchain at 3am? 👇 not financial advice.
